title: 第25章 漂亮姐姐第26章 丹宗弟子
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 经过数个时辰的赶路，玄天城已经遥遥在望。
就在此时，莫阳神色微变……
因为他发现前方有一道身影竟然就这么踏空而行，没有借助任何外力。
他长这么大，还是第一次见到这样的强者。
此人竟然能凭借自身的力量御空而行！
“宗师之上，以往的武道盛会从未出现过这种强者……”徐欣也是吃惊不已，忍不住低声轻呼。
因为修者唯有超越宗师，登临战王境界，才能做到御空而行，在不借助任何外力的情况下，只凭借自身的力量，脚踏虚空，如履平地。
而且前方的还是一个女子，看上去很年轻，似乎不过双十年华……
她身穿一袭长裙，长长的秀发犹如瀑布般垂至腰间，随着微风轻轻摆动，身姿婀娜。
如今踏空而行，无形中给人一种秀雅绝俗之感。
“啧啧，仙气飘飘，应该是个漂亮姐姐吧，还这么厉害，也不知是哪家的姑娘！”莫阳一边打量一边轻语。
他本想说不知是哪个势力的弟子，只是话语说出来便感觉变了味。
徐欣一听，当下就是一声冷哼。
暗想有些秉性果然是天生的，看到一个漂亮姑娘便露出这种德行，也难怪年纪轻轻便捣鼓那些不正经的丹药。
正当几人吃惊的凝目打量时，那人微微侧头，两道淡漠的目光扫来。
莫阳目光看去，刚好能看到一张侧脸，愣了愣，下意识的开口道：“啧啧，果然漂亮！”
徐欣无语到了极点，不过还是急忙提醒道：“你还看，这种强者必定来自某个大势力，根本不是你能招惹得起的，小心她回头就把你眼珠子挖出来！”
莫阳盯着看了几眼，随后不以为意的撇嘴道：“师姐，你这就不对了，长那么漂亮还不让人看，这是什么理，就如世间美景，唯有懂得欣赏它的人，那美景才有意义不是！”
“况且我天性纯善，只是以纯洁的目光去欣赏！”
徐欣彻底无语，见过无耻的，从没见过这么无耻的，盯着人家姑娘只差没流口水了，居然还说的这么冠冕堂皇。
苏菲儿蹙眉思索，嘀咕道：“莫阳哥哥说的好像有些道理！”
听苏菲儿这么一说，徐欣脸都黑了，苏菲儿这段时间变得连她都有些不认识了，如今处处帮着莫阳说话，这种无耻的借口苏菲儿居然还说有道理！
他们说话间，前方的女子已经远去，几息后彻底不见了踪影。
此时莫阳才轻叹，道：“如此年轻便能御空而行……她好像也朝着玄天城的方向去了，莫非是来观战的？”
莫阳心中难以平复，由此可见那些大势力中的天骄有多么可怕，这般年纪，但却已经有着战王甚至是战王之上的修为，比他高了不是一点半点……
别说是他，就算是灵虚宗的长老也差了对方足足数个大境界。
徐欣也不解，以往武道盛会，她从不曾见过这种层次的强者，而且对方太年轻，十有八九是某个大势力的天骄人物。
四宗门武道盛会这种事情，按理来说根本不会引起这种天才的兴趣才对。
一行人来到玄天城后，他们便被带到了相应的区域，客栈也早已准备好了。
“你们先熟悉一下这里，四宗门的人都已经到了，出去切记别惹事！”三长老交代了他们几句，随后便去准备相关事宜了。
看着其他几位弟子都跟着齐衡离开，莫阳也走出了客栈，这座城池很是繁华，他第一次来，打算出去四处看看。
“莫阳哥哥，我们一起出去走走吧，听说这里到了晚上才有趣，吃的玩的都很多！”苏菲儿显然早已在等莫阳了，此时很是兴奋。
随后她又硬生生将满脸不情愿的徐欣也拉了出来。
莫阳无奈的点了点头，临行前宗主让他多照看一下苏菲儿，如今齐衡等人都离开了，他也不好拒绝。
“方才进城的时候我看到城内有一家丹药铺，我打算去先卖几枚丹药，去购买一柄剑！”莫阳开口。
他一直琢磨着这件事，他手中一直没一件像样的兵器，四长老虽然给他留下了一柄剑，但之前被他埋进四长老的衣冠冢内了。
content_en:
After several hours of traveling, Xuantian City was already in sight.
At this moment, Mo Yang's expression changed slightly...
Because he discovered that there was a figure in front of him walking through the air without any external force.
This is the first time in his life that he has seen such a strong man.
This person can actually fly through the air with his own strength!
"Beyond the Grandmaster, there has never been such a strong person in previous martial arts gatherings..." Xu Xin was also surprised and couldn't help but whisper softly.
Because only by surpassing the master and reaching the realm of the King of War can a cultivator be able to walk in the air. Without the help of any external force, he can only rely on his own strength to step on the void as if he were walking on flat ground.
And the person in front is still a woman, she looks very young, she seems to be no more than twenty years old...
She was wearing a long dress, with her long hair hanging down to her waist like a waterfall, swaying gently in the breeze, and her figure was graceful.
Now walking in the air gives people a sense of elegance and elegance.
"Tsk, tsk, she has a fairy spirit. She must be a beautiful sister. She is so powerful. I don't know which girl she is from!" Mo Yang whispered as he looked at her.
He wanted to say that he was a disciple of an unknown force, but when he said the words, his taste changed.
When Xu Xin heard this, she snorted coldly.
I secretly thought that some qualities are indeed innate. Seeing a beautiful girl reveals such virtues. It is no wonder that she is tinkering with those unethical elixirs at a young age.
Just as several people stared at him in surprise, the man turned his head slightly and glanced at him with two indifferent eyes.
Mo Yang looked around and could just see a side face. He was stunned and subconsciously said: "Tsk, tsk, it's really beautiful!"
Xu Xin was speechless to the extreme, but she still hurriedly warned: "Look, this kind of strong man must come from some big force. You can't afford to offend him at all. Be careful when she turns around and digs out your eyeballs!"
Mo Yang stared at it for a few times, then curled his lips and said indifferently: "Sister, you are wrong. You are so beautiful and you don't want others to see you. What's the point? Just like the beautiful scenery in the world, only those who know how to appreciate it can the beautiful scenery be meaningful!"
"Besides, I have a pure and kind nature, so I just appreciate it with pure eyes!"
Xu Xin was completely speechless. She had seen shameless people before, but she had never seen such a shameless person. She almost stopped drooling when she stared at this girl, but she actually said something so high-sounding.
Sophie frowned in thought and muttered: "What Brother Mo Yang said seems to make sense!"
Hearing what Su Feier said, Xu Xin's face turned dark. Su Feier had become a little bit unfamiliar with her during this period. Now she was helping Mo Yang in everything. Su Feier's shameless excuse actually made sense!
While they were talking, the woman in front of them had already gone away, and after a few breaths she completely disappeared.
At this time, Mo Yangcai sighed softly and said: "She is able to fly in the air at such a young age... She seems to be heading towards Xuantian City. Could it be that she is here to watch the battle?"
Mo Yang couldn't calm down in his heart. This shows how terrifying the geniuses among the big forces are. At such an age, they already have the cultivation level of a war king or even a war king. They are not a little bit higher than him...
Not to mention him, even the elders of Lingxu Sect were several realms behind him.
Xu Xin also didn't understand. She had never seen a strong man of this level in previous martial arts events, and the other person was too young. He was most likely a talented person from some big force.
Logically speaking, things like the Four Sects' Martial Arts Festival would not arouse the interest of such a genius at all.
After the group arrived at Xuantian City, they were taken to the corresponding area, and the inn was already ready.
"You guys should get familiar with this place first. People from the four sects have already arrived. Remember not to cause trouble when you go out!" The third elder told them a few words, and then went to prepare relevant matters.
Seeing several other disciples follow Qi Heng and leave, Mo Yang also walked out of the inn. This city was very prosperous. It was his first time here and he planned to go out and look around.
"Brother Mo Yang, let's go out for a walk together. I heard that this place is interesting only at night, and there are a lot of things to eat and do!" Sophie was obviously waiting for Mo Yang and was very excited at this time.
Then she forcefully pulled Xu Xin out, who was full of reluctance.
Mo Yang nodded helplessly. Before leaving, the sect leader asked him to take care of Sophie more. Now that Qi Heng and others have left, he can't refuse.
"When I entered the city just now, I saw an elixir shop in the city. I plan to go there and sell a few elixirs to buy a sword!" Mo Yang said.
He had been thinking about this matter. He never had a decent weapon in his hand. Although the fourth elder left him a sword, he had buried it in the fourth elder's tomb.
